svg.title: How the crew hands work around
svg.desc: The director (Claude) briefs each member with a TASK.md and merges each RESULT.md. I pitch: creative director, scriptwriter, brand designer in parallel; you pick a concept. II plan: script, storyboard and animatic, researcher checks claims, creative director signs off; you sign off. III build: motion designers per scene, sound designer, voice director in parallel. IV review: the critic; fixes go back to the same member. V deliver: showtime qa, then MP4 and HTML video. Footage jobs: editor, sound designer, researcher, critic.
